sources.title: BiRefNet-HRSOD huggingface.co api & ZhengPeng7 BiRefNet-HRSOD github AI ...
sources.snippet: BiRefNet-HRSOD huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides BiRefNet-HRSOD's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this ZhengPeng7 BiRefNet-HRSOD model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the BiRefNet-HRSOD model, and also provides paid use of the BiRefNet-HRSOD. Support call BiRefNet-HRSOD model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.
